title: Video generation lands with Veo and Seedance
summary:
Video generation joins the garden, while the community gets clearer ways to participate and the public site gets its December tune-up.

Pollinations can now generate video through Veo and Seedance, bringing another medium into the same open infrastructure already used for images, text, audio, and assorted experiments.

A new login-provider voting issue gives the community a direct place to weigh in on sign-in options, while tier and Pollen values were refreshed alongside new Claude skills for managing tiers and making issues.

Chat.Pollinations.AI was synced with its website code, the site messaging now more clearly describes a community-built project, and a December news banner keeps visitors pointed at what changed.
